item.title: Custom Parser Implementation
item.description: Building a parser from scratch provides deep insights into how programming languages work. This project implements a recursive descent parser for a small functional language. Language Features The language supports: Lambda expressions: λx. x + 1 Let bindings: let x = 5 in x * 2 Arithmetic operations Function application Tokenization First, we convert the input string into tokens: def tokenize(input_str): tokens = [] current = "" for char in input_str: if char in " \t\n": if current: tokens.
